summary: Anchorage Neighborhood Health Center in Alaska has started notifying patients about a criminal cyberattack that involved unauthorized access to or acquisition of some of their protected health information. The cyberattack was detected on August 25, 2025, and the investigation confirmed unauthorized access to its network from August 24 to August 25, 2025. The review of the exposed files was completed on October 10, 2025, when it was confirmed that the data exposed in the incident included names, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, driver’s license/state identification numbers, medical treatment information, and/or health insurance information. Anchorage Neighborhood Health Center said it has already implemented a series of cybersecurity enhancements and plans to take other steps to strengthen security.
